package outbox

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

const maximumStoredErrorLength = 2000

// Clock makes publication leasing and retries deterministic.
type Clock interface {
	Now() time.Time
}

// Relay publishes one sequential, bounded student outbox batch.
type Relay struct {
	Outbox         repository.Outbox
	Publisher      domain.DurableEventPublisher
	Clock          Clock
	WorkerID       string
	BatchSize      int
	LockTTL        time.Duration
	PublishTimeout time.Duration
	RetryBaseDelay time.Duration
	RetryMaxDelay  time.Duration
}

// ProcessBatch delivers at least once and marks only acknowledged events complete.
func (relay Relay) ProcessBatch(ctx context.Context) (int, error) {
	if err := relay.Validate(); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	now := relay.Clock.Now().UTC()
	events, err := relay.Outbox.Claim(ctx, repository.OutboxClaim{
		WorkerID:    relay.WorkerID,
		Limit:       relay.BatchSize,
		Now:         now,
		LockedUntil: now.Add(relay.LockTTL),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	var failures []error
	for _, event := range events {
		publishContext, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, relay.PublishTimeout)
		publishErr := relay.Publisher.Publish(publishContext, event)
		cancel()
		if publishErr != nil {
			retryAt := relay.Clock.Now().UTC().Add(relay.retryDelay(event.Attempts))
			message := truncateError(publishErr.Error())
			if markErr := relay.Outbox.MarkFailed(ctx, event.EventID, relay.WorkerID, message, retryAt); markErr != nil {
				failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("publish %s: %w; mark failed: %v", event.EventID, publishErr, markErr))
			} else {
				failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("publish %s: %w", event.EventID, publishErr))
			}
			continue
		}
		if err := relay.Outbox.MarkPublished(ctx, event.EventID, relay.WorkerID, relay.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("mark published %s: %w", event.EventID, err))
		}
	}
	return len(events), errors.Join(failures...)
}

// Validate checks relay dependencies and ensures a sequential batch cannot
// consume its lease under the configured per-message timeout.
func (relay Relay) Validate() error {
	if relay.Outbox == nil || relay.Publisher == nil || relay.Clock == nil ||
		strings.TrimSpace(relay.WorkerID) == "" || relay.BatchSize <= 0 || relay.LockTTL <= 0 ||
		relay.PublishTimeout <= 0 || relay.LockTTL <= time.Duration(relay.BatchSize)*relay.PublishTimeout ||
		relay.RetryBaseDelay <= 0 || relay.RetryMaxDelay < relay.RetryBaseDelay {
		return errors.New("invalid outbox relay configuration")
	}
	return nil
}

func (relay Relay) retryDelay(attempt int) time.Duration {
	if attempt < 1 {
		attempt = 1
	}
	delay := relay.RetryBaseDelay
	for current := 1; current < attempt && delay < relay.RetryMaxDelay; current++ {
		if delay > relay.RetryMaxDelay/2 {
			return relay.RetryMaxDelay
		}
		delay *= 2
	}
	if delay > relay.RetryMaxDelay {
		return relay.RetryMaxDelay
	}
	return delay
}

func truncateError(message string) string {
	if len(message) <= maximumStoredErrorLength {
		return message
	}
	return message[:maximumStoredErrorLength]
}
